description_en: Queries the backup tasks and task progress of a specified Supabase instance
description_zh: 查询指定 Supabase 实例的备份任务及任务进度
name: ListSupabaseBackupJobs

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html operation to query available region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html接口查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the Supabase instance. You can obtain instance ID from the Supabase page in the console
parameters.help_zh: Supabase实例ID，可以在控制台Supabase页面获取
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

Automated: automatic backup
Manual: manual backup

If this parameter is not specified, all backup tasks are returned
parameters.help_zh:
备份模式。取值说明：

Automated：系统自动备份。
Manual：手动备份。

如果不传，则返回所有
parameters.name: backup_mode

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return for this request
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求返回的最大记录数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The paging token. Do not specify this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, specify the NextToken value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询标记。首次查询不传入；后续查询传入上一次响应返回的 NextToken
parameters.name: next_token

BackupJobId.description_en: The ID of the backup task

BackupMode.description_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:
Automated: automatic backup
Manual: manual backup
BackupMode.description_zh:
备份模式。取值说明：
Automated：系统自动备份
Manual：手动备份

BackupStatus.description_en: The status of the backup task. Valid statuses include: schedule (waiting to be scheduled) and backup (in progress)
BackupStatus.description_zh: 备份任务状态。已确认的状态包括：schedule（等待调度）、backup（备份中）

Process.description_en: The progress percentage of the backup task, such as 0%. This value may be an empty string when the task is in the schedule (waiting to be scheduled) state
Process.description_zh: 备份任务进度百分比，例如 0%。任务处于 schedule（等待调度）状态时可能为空字符串

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the backup task. The time is displayed in UTC in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. This value may be an empty string when the task is in the schedule (waiting to be scheduled) state
StartTime.description_zh: 备份任务开始时间，使用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。任务处于 schedule（等待调度）状态时可能为空字符串

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries to return for this request
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次请求返回的最大记录数

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page, which can be used as the NextToken parameter in the next request
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页的查询标记，可作为下次请求的 NextToken
